subhead: By announcing a decree targeting foreigners who have 'spread messages of hate' against the Argentine people, particularly during the World Cup, the president is tapping into the country's heightened patriotism in an effort to regain control of the political agenda after weeks away from the public eye.

title: UEFA, CONCACAF target Infantino after FIFA shelves World Cup private investment plan
subhead: European football's governing body welcomed the withdrawal of the proposal to allow private investment in the World Cup. But the UEFA said that the FIFA president had lost their and other football family members' 'confidence' with his 'shabby, back room, opaque deal.'

title: Mexican candidates forced to retake university entrance exam after suspicions of AI-driven cheating
subhead: Entrance exams for the various programs at the National Autonomous University of Mexico, which students took remotely for the first time, produced scores much higher than in previous years, raising suspicions about the use of artificial intelligence assistance.
